onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event from the beginning of the first datapoint. Negative onsets account for events before the first stored data point.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds from onset. Must be zero, positive, or 'n/a' if unavailable. A zero value indicates an impulse event.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: Integer event ID assigned per file by the BIDS writer (MNE-BIDS) to each distinct trial_type; it is not the source stim code (see trial_type) and may differ between files.

trial_type.Description: Source stim code as 'stimcode-<N>', N = value of the source 'stim' vector (fingerflex.zip:fingerflex/data/mv/mv_stim.mat). Each event spans one constant segment of the stim vector (onset at the sample where the code changes; duration until the next change). The full vector is kept verbatim in the STIMCODE channel.

Levels.stimcode--1: Source stim code -1; not defined in the fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522) (present in the source stim vector).
Levels.stimcode-0: Inter-stimulus interval (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522), code table of the companion <code>_stim.mat 'stim' variable: labeled epochs encasing the actual movement types)
Levels.stimcode-1: Movement epoch: thumb (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522), <code>_stim.mat code table)
Levels.stimcode-2: Movement epoch: index finger (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522), <code>_stim.mat code table)
Levels.stimcode-3: Movement epoch: middle finger (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522), <code>_stim.mat code table)
Levels.stimcode-4: Movement epoch: ring finger (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522), <code>_stim.mat code table)
Levels.stimcode-5: Movement epoch: little finger (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522), <code>_stim.mat code table)
